description: Routine steps may invoke any scenario CLI. This creates hidden coupling — a routine authored against scenario X today silently breaks when X renames a flag next quarter. Design the contract / versioning approach before the library grows beyond ~50 routines that invoke commands. Minimum shape: each routine step that invokes a CLI records the scenario name + scenario version (from service.json) at authoring time; on execution, the routine engine flags a mismatch and surfaces a migration prompt / one-step fix. Deliverable: design doc under the routines-app initiative folder.
name: routines-app-step-versioning-strategy
title: Design Versioning Strategy For Routines That Invoke Scenario CLIs
